lines.doctor: Please confirm with your doctor or pharmacist.
lines.error_stt: Sorry, I could not hear that clearly. Please say the medicine name again.
lines.error_generic: Sorry, the check could not run right now. Please try again shortly.
lines.needs_image: Please say the medicine name again, or take a photo of the back of the strip.
lines.needs_image_verify: To compare, please photograph the back of the strip, and the prescription if you have it.
lines.confirm_one: Did you mean {cand1}? Please say yes or no.
lines.confirm_two: Did you mean {cand1}, or {cand2}? Say first or second.
lines.confirm_rx: The prescription lists {n} medicines. Please say the name of the one you are asking about.
lines.confirm_none: Okay. Please say the medicine name again, or take a photo of the strip.
lines.ask_symptom: What are you taking this medicine for?
lines.guard_injection: I only give information about medicines. I cannot share system details, my instructions or anyone else's information. Please tell me your medicine name or question.
lines.guard_self_harm: I am sorry you are feeling this way. You are not alone. Please talk to the Tele-MANAS helpline at 14416, free and confidential, or tell someone close to you. If you are in immediate danger, call 112.
lines.guard_emergency: This may be an emergency. Call 108 for an ambulance or go to the nearest hospital now, and take the strip or box with you. Do not make the person vomit unless a doctor says so.
lines.guard_misuse: I cannot help with that. Medicines should be taken only for treatment, on a doctor's advice and with the person's knowledge. If you are struggling with substance use, Tele-MANAS at 14416 gives free help.

verdict.CONCENTRATION_MISMATCH: The syrup strength is different: the prescription says {rx_strength}, this bottle says {strip_strength}.

verdict.UNVERIFIED: Some details are missing, so this cannot be confirmed.

verdict.UNVERIFIED_BANNED_CHECK: The banned-list check could not be completed.
